title: How many Europeans don't exercise enough?
subtitle: By 2025, Portugal had the highest share of insufficiently active people at 51.7 per cent, while Sweden had the lowest at 8.7 per cent.
textNote: Percent of population attaining less than 150 minutes of moderate-intensity physical activity per week, or less than 75 minutes of vigorous-intensity physical activity per week, or equivalent. Population aged 18 or over.
